decisions.reason: As a distant diversification with no visible traction signals and weak fit to the firm's maritime-digital direction, it is the clearest candidate to free resources for better-aligned options.
This service builds on the firm's crewing capabilities and client base, so its uncertainty is still worth carrying given likely low incremental cost.
The new maritime education programme already shows a six-institution partner network and strongly leverages the firm's training assets and sector focus.
The firm has already demonstrated successful delivery for all relevant vessels before the FuelEU deadline, making this a high-fit and now validated compliance offering.
The dashboard is strategically aligned with digitalisation and emissions compliance and is integrated into the firm's existing PAL software, which lowers the cost of keeping it.
The cost simulation tool is an adjacent software option with strong regulatory relevance and low carrying cost because it is integrated into the firm's existing ship-management platform.
